That notification confirms the T&T research agent's completion. Its report was already delivered and I folded its corroborating details into my closing note above. Nothing further is outstanding.

Final status: the CBRE research report covering August 1 through October 23, 2026 was delivered to you via SubagentHandback. It covers all five requested topics with claim, source URL, publication date, and primary-versus-secondary labeling. The key conclusions were:

- Turner & Townsend is **not** bought out: CBRE holds 70%, the partner put option runs January 1, 2027 to March 31, 2030, and no post-July-2026 buyout news exists
- Onnec acquisition announced October 20, 2026, worth up to roughly £760M / $1.01B
- Q3 2026 results reported October 22, 2026, with critical infrastructure revenue up 80%
- North America Data Center Trends H1 2026 published August 27, 2026
- No AI product news, no investor day, and no executive changes in the window

Method caveat worth carrying forward: WebSearch was unauthorized in this environment, so the research ran on Bing News, direct primary-source fetches, Google News RSS, UK Companies House, and SEC EDGAR. Absence findings mean "no announcement found in the sources checked," not proof of non-occurrence.
